author: HBO Max
description:
On Season 2, Episode 8 of DC Studios Showcase: The Official Podcast, Frankey and Coy sit down with Kyle Chandler and Aaron Pierre, the stars of DC Studios’ Lanterns, for an insider conversation about Hal Jordan, John Stewart, Comic-Con, and the grim detective story unfolding in the DC Universe. The two Green Lanterns open up about the characters, their chemistry, and what it meant to finally experience the DC fandom firsthand.

From Kyle Chandler's wild Comic-Con experience in a Stormtrooper helmet to Aaron Pierre's take on the dark, deeply human world of Lanterns, Frankey and Coy get into what makes this Green Lantern story different. They also debate Hal vs. John as detectives, the meaning behind John's relationship with birds, Sinestro's role, the Manhunters, and how Lanterns could connect to Man of Tomorrow.

✅ Kyle Chandler reveals what really happened when he hit San Diego Comic-Con in disguise as Hal Jordan
✅ Aaron Pierre talks about the overwhelming fan response to Lanterns an

description:
On Season 1, Episode 7 of Stuart Fails to Save the Universe Official Podcast, Big Bang Theory fans get exclusive access to Riki Lindhome’s return as Ramona Nowitzki and the making of “Spoiler: Dexys Midnight Runners Get a Royalty Payment.” Felicia Day and Wil Wheaton talk with Riki about Ramona’s “bottomless pit of rage,” then VFX supervisor Tom Mahoney reveals how the team built the episode’s telepathy, centaurs, Matrix homage and multiverse mayhem.

✅ Riki Lindhome explains why Ramona remains the same person in every universe, just with different levels of rage and success
✅ How one text to Bill Prady helped bring Riki back to the Big Bang Theory universe
✅ Why Riki became the cast’s unofficial “Come On Eileen” vocal coach
✅ Tom Mahoney reveals how each character’s centaur body was inspired by their real-life pet
✅ The behind-the-scenes tricks that created SFTSTU’s universe bubbles, Matrix homage and reality-bending chase. Check out the Matrix here: https://www.warnerbros.com/movies
